QUOTE: `constant_time_impl.h:42-54` defines `MBEDTLS_CT_ASM` only when `MBEDTLS_HAVE_ASM` is set and the compiler is GNU-style (`__GNUC__`, not old armcc). Per-architecture branches then select `MBEDTLS_CT_ARM_ASM`, `MBEDTLS_CT_AARCH64_ASM`, `MBEDTLS_CT_X86_64_ASM` or `MBEDTLS_CT_X86_ASM`.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says MBEDTLS_CT_ASM is defined in the header from MBEDTLS_HAVE_ASM plus compiler macros such as `__GNUC__`. That makes it derived rather than set in the config file, even though the answer never says "not in mbedtls_config.h".
